headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Linklaters act on Edelweiss Alternatives ₹1,200 crore IPO

detail: EAAA India Alternatives Limited has made an initial public offering of equity shares comprised an offer for sale of 7,207,207 equity shares aggregating to ₹1,200 crore. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co acted as the legal counsel to EAAA India Alternative and its promoters, Edelweiss Securities and Investments Private Limited and Edelweiss Financial Services Limited, on this IPO. The transaction team consisted of Nikhil Naredi (Partner), Harsh Loonker (Principal Associate), Rakshita Poddar (Senior Associate), Associates Najeeb Din and Thejaswi Melarkode. Nikhil Naredi Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acted as the Indian legal counsel to the book running lead managers on this IPO.
